//: agent-pipeline config. Committed. Private values go in pipeline.local.json, which is gitignored. See docs/config.md. Fill in what your project has and delete the rest: e2e tests, user docs, screenshots and databases are all optional.

e2e.//: End-to-end tests, one file at a time: a browser suite for a web app, real client calls for an API, real commands for a CLI. Leave command null when there are none.

deploy.//: requiredChecks: health by default. A service with stored data adds backup, load, http and restarts.

docs.//: guide is the main user docs file. shortcutSources pairs source files, such as a key map or a CLI's option table, with the shortcutDocs that describe them. screenshots applies to software with a UI.
